newsitem.title: GERMANY: German punks go on rampage in eastern Germany.
newsitem.headline: German punks go on rampage in eastern Germany.

text.p: Around 60 youths threw stones at police, vandalised cars and smashed windows in the east German city of Halle, police said on Sunday.

Police said 15 officers were injured in the clashes, which began at a right-wing rally on Saturday evening and continued at a nearby rock concert afterwards. Twelve men aged between 17 and 27 were detained temporarily.
